valid_relation_types = set(constraints.get('relation_types', {}).keys()) if isinstance(constraints.get('relation_types'), dict) else set(constraints.get('relation_types', []))

all_gold_ents = []
all_pred_rels = []
all_gold_rels = []

rv_violations = 0  # relation type violations
dr_violations = 0  # dangling relation violations
total_pred_ents = 0
total_pred_rels = 0

for r in results:
    gold_ents = r.get('gold_entities', [])
    gold_rels = r.get('gold_relations', [])
    parsed = r.get('parsed_output', {})
    if not parsed:
        continue
    pred_ents = parsed.get('entities', [])
    pred_rels = parsed.get('relations', [])

    ge_set = set((e['text'], e['type']) for e in gold_ents)
    pe_set = set((e['text'], e['type']) for e in pred_ents)
    all_gold_ents.append(ge_set)
    all_pred_ents.append(pe_set)

    # Gold relation set: (head, tail, type)
    gr_set = set((r2['head'], r2['tail'], r2['type']) for r2 in gold_rels)
    pr_set = set((r2['head'], r2['tail'], r2['type']) for r2 in pred_rels)

    total_pred_ents += len(pred_ents)
    total_pred_rels += len(pred_rels)

    for e in pred_ents:

        if rel['head'] not in pred_ent_texts or rel['tail'] not in pred_ent_texts:
            dr_violations += 1

# Micro F1 calculation
def micro_f1(pred_sets, gold_sets):
    tp = fp = fn = 0
    for ps, gs in zip(pred_sets, gold_sets):
        tp += len(ps & gs)
        fp += len(ps - gs)
        fn += len(gs - ps)
    p = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0
    r = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0
